QUOTE: Direct: many handlers, such as `handlePosts` (`post.ts:618`) and `handleUsers`, call `this.batchRecords(...)` themselves after preparing models.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says writes funnel through `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords` but never says each mixin is constrained to extend ServerDataOperatorBase, which is why they all inherit it. It also says handlers reach it in two ways, one of which only prepares models and doesn't write.
